versions.name: Camp Emerald Bay

features.note: Reached only by boat from Berth 85 in San Pedro; there is no road access to the camp.
An on-site marine science centre and aquarium.
PADI open-water SCUBA certifications and the SCUBA merit badge in the kelp forests and reefs off Catalina.
American Sailing Association affiliate school offering small-boat sailing certification.
War-canoe program, including an overnight paddle to Parson's Beach.
Nature and ecology program, including stargazing.
Optional Rugged treks for older Scouts: bike-and-hike, Trans-Catalina backpacking, and a war-canoe circumnavigation of the island.
Scouts can register individually, not only as part of a unit.
Mountain biking on the island's West End.
Trans-Catalina Trail backpacking trek in the Rugged Trekkers program.
Dedicated Rugged programming for older Scouts.

versions.summary: Western LA County Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp on Catalina Island.

sources.citation: Community correction via Camp Finder Suggest-a-Correction form; submitted by camp staff 2026-08-12 (submission KpW95L8), kept anonymous at submitter request. Feature additions verified against the camp's own program pages.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
